2.1 Members. The Members of the Company, their initial Capital Contributions, and their Percentage Interests are set forth on Exhibit A.

2.2 Additional Contributions. No Member is required to make any additional Capital Contribution unless approved by Members holding a majority of the Percentage Interests.

2.2 Additional Contributions. No Member is required to make any additional Capital Contribution unless approved by Members holding a majority of the Percentage Interests.

2.3 Capital Accounts. A separate capital account shall be maintained for each Member in accordance with Treasury Regulations Section 1.704-1(b)(2)(iv).

3.1 Allocations. Profits and losses for each fiscal year shall be allocated among the Members in proportion to their Percentage Interests.

3.2 Distributions. Distributions of available cash shall be made at the times and in the amounts determined by the Manager, in proportion to the Members' Percentage Interests.

3.2 Distributions. Distributions of available cash shall be made at the times and in the amounts determined by the Manager, in proportion to the Members' Percentage Interests.

ARTICLE 4. MANAGEMENT

4.2 Authority of the Manager. The Manager has sole authority to sign leases, open and close Company bank accounts, and execute documents on behalf of the Company, except that the sale or refinancing of any real property requires the written consent of Members holding at least seventy-five percent (75%) of the Percentage Interests.

4.3 Successor Manager. If the Manager ceases to serve, Members holding a majority of the Percentage Interests shall appoint a successor Manager.

4.3 Successor Manager. If the Manager ceases to serve, Members holding a majority of the Percentage Interests shall appoint a successor Manager.

ARTICLE 5. TRANSFERS

This Operating Agreement is made effective as of June 1, 2021, by and among the Members listed on Exhibit A.

ARTICLE 1. FORMATION

5.1 Restrictions. No Member may transfer all or any part of its interest without the prior written consent of the other Members, except a transfer by a Member to a revocable trust of which that Member is a trustee.

ARTICLE 6. BOOKS, RECORDS, AND TAX RETURNS
